findings_to_judge.finding: NIO absorbed a RMB 10,000/vehicle purchase-tax subsidy on ES8 orders locked through 30 April 2026 and then discontinued it mid-Q2 — Deutsche Bank named that discontinuation as a cause of the June ES8 order shortfall. ES8 (Gen 3) was 33,474 units of Q2's 107,658, so removing RMB 10,000/unit from even ~18,000 Q2 deliveries retains ~RMB 180m of margin, which is the whole of Deutsche Bank's ~RMB 180m Q2 non-GAAP net income estimate. The 2.1% unit miss versus the 110-115k guide was in part the price paid for that margin, not purely demand weakness.

NIO's 20-F for FY2025, filed 2026-04-10, discloses that headcount fell to 35,032 from 45,635 — 10,603 jobs, the sharpest single-year cut in its history — with product and software development down 40% to 6,912 from 11,528 and 'user experience' (sales, marketing, service) down 30.8% to 16,885 from 24,410. NIO never gave aggregate numbers during 2025, calling it 'organizational optimization'. Q2 2026 volume was +29% sequentially (107,658 vs 83,465) against that reduced cost base.

NIO's year-on-year growth rate collapses mechanically from the August number onward on base effects, and 1 September is NIO's established monthly-delivery publication slot, so the August figure plausibly lands in the same tape as Q2 results and the Q3 guide. July 2026 was 35,934, +71.0% YoY against a July 2025 base of ~21,017. But August 2025 was 31,305 and September 2025 was 34,749 (Q3 2025 total 87,071) — the base steps up ~49% in one month. Bottom-up August 2026 indicators point to roughly flat-to-modestly-up sequentially (third-gen ES8's latest 10,000 units took 30 days as of 21 August; Onvo L60 at 3,201 units in the first 28 days), implying Q3 near 113-118k and YoY growth roughly halving to ~+30%.

NIO's smart-driving chief Ren Shaoqing has founded a separately registered embodied-AI/physical-AI-foundation-model company that has already reached a unicorn-level valuation, and NIO reportedly plans to make a strategic investment in it while Ren stays on as NIO's smart-driving chief. Reported 21 and 24 August 2026, after NIO's last public communication.

NIO has now missed its own delivery guidance in consecutive disclosures — June 2026 came in at 40,597 against a 42,900-47,900 guide, and Q2 at 107,658 against 110,000-115,000 — so whatever Q3 unit and revenue range management gives on 1 September starts with an impaired discount factor.
